limitations: Browser UI not exercised; analysis is of the native engine card data and public protocol surface.
No game was played for this issue; no pre/post state snapshots because the prerequisite card does not exist in the implemented set.
The underlying single-slot pending_replacement defect is not disputed; this verdict reports only that the backfill cannot trigger it with real cards on the pinned release.
notes: Full card-data scan: 2710 cards with replacements (2657 Mandatory, 119 Optional, 36 MayCost).
All 95 Optional Moved replacements are enter-the-battlefield replacements (copy/riot/unleash, valid_card SelfRef); none applies to a graveyard move.
All 36 MayCost replacements are ETB (shocklands etc.); none applies to a spell's graveyard move.
The sole Optional Discard replacement is Library of Leng; it cannot raise a choice for the spell's own 608.2n move (Discard-gated, per the issue).
Pulmonic Sliver (the only real optional graveyard-move replacement) is unimplemented: replacements=[], parse_warnings=[SwallowedClause].
CreateGameWithSettings accepts only named cards from card-data.json; no custom GameScenario/ReplacementDefinition facility exists on the protocol.
Related root cause reproduced for #6360 on v0.110.0 today via WebSocket (separate issue, separate evidence); not relabelled as this bug.
result: A1 card_data_scan: passed; A2 optional_replacement_for_spell_move: failed (no implemented optional replacement applies to a resolving spell's 608.2n graveyard move); A3 protocol_fixture_support: failed (no custom-fixture facility on the public protocol)
scope: Static analysis of the pinned v0.110.0 card-data.json replacement table plus the public WebSocket protocol surface, to determine whether the issue's parked-replacement-choice overwrite can be triggered with real cards. Native engine only.

server_identity.signature_note: v0.110.0 is the pinned release dir and still the latest stable engine release on GitHub (published 2026-10-14); ServerHello 0.110.0/9bfd12e/protocol 142 confirmed by live handshake on 127.0.0.1:9374.
